candidates.label: Death and life created as a test of best conduct
candidates.definition: In 67:2: He who created death and life to test you as to which of you is best in deed, and He is the Exalted in Might the Forgiving.

evidence.excerpt: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبۡلُوَكُمۡ أَيُّكُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ عَمَلٗاۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفُورُ

candidates.label: Seven layered heavens without inconsistency as cosmic sign
candidates.definition: In 67:3-4: He who created seven heavens in layers; you do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency; so return your vision to the sky do you see any breaks; then return your vision twice again, your vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.

evidence.excerpt: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٖ طِبَاقٗاۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِي خَلۡقِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٖۖ فَٱرۡجِعِ ٱلۡبَصَرَ هَلۡ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٖ

evidence.excerpt: ثُمَّ ٱرۡجِعِ ٱلۡبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيۡنِ يَنقَلِبۡ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ خَاسِئٗا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Hell's rage and keeper-interrogation exposing denial of the warner
candidates.definition: In 67:7-9: When they are thrown into it they hear from it a dreadful inhaling while it boils up; it almost bursts with rage; every time a company is thrown into it its keepers ask them did there not come to you a warner; they will say yes a warner had come to us but we denied.

evidence.excerpt: إِذَآ أُلۡقُواْ فِيهَا سَمِعُواْ لَهَا شَهِيقٗا وَهِيَ تَفُورُ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلۡغَيۡظِۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلۡقِيَ فِيهَا فَوۡجٞ سَأَلَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ نَذِيرٞ

evidence.excerpt: قَالُواْ بَلَىٰ قَدۡ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٞ فَكَذَّبۡنَا وَقُلۡنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَيۡءٍ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلٖ كَبِيرٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Regretful admission that listening or reasoning would have saved them
candidates.definition: In 67:10-11: And they will say if only we had been listening or reasoning we would not be among the companions of the Blaze; and they will admit their sin so it is alienation for the companions of the Blaze.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡ كُنَّا نَسۡمَعُ أَوۡ نَعۡقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِيٓ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Fear of the Lord unseen earning forgiveness and great reward
candidates.definition: In 67:12: Indeed those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٞ وَأَجۡرٞ كَبِيرٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Earth made tame for livelihood with provision from Him alone
candidates.definition: In 67:15: It is He who made the earth tame for you so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision and to Him is the resurrection.

evidence.excerpt: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ ذَلُولٗا فَٱمۡشُواْ فِي مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُواْ مِن رِّزۡقِهِۦۖ وَإِلَيۡهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: False security challenged through earthquake and stone-storm warnings
candidates.definition: In 67:16-18: Do you feel secure that He who holds authority in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway; or do you feel secure that He who holds authority in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones; then you would know how severe was My warning; and already had those before them denied and how terrible was My reproach.

evidence.excerpt: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخۡسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَمُورُ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: أَمۡ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ حَاصِبٗاۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ كَيۡفَ نَذِيرِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Birds held aloft by the Most Merciful as observable sign
candidates.definition: In 67:19: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and sometimes folded in; none holds them aloft except the Most Merciful; indeed He is of all things Seeing.

evidence.excerpt: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱلطَّيۡرِ فَوۡقَهُمۡ صَـٰٓفَّـٰتٖ وَيَقۡبِضۡنَۚ مَا يُمۡسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءِۭ بَصِيرٌ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Little gratitude despite hearing, vision and hearts
candidates.definition: In 67:23: Say it is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَكُمۡ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَ وَٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةَۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تَشۡكُرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Knowledge of the Hour exclusive to Allah; Messenger only a clear warner
candidates.definition: In 67:25-26: And they say when is this promise if you should be truthful; say the knowledge is only with Allah and I am only a clear warner.

evidence.excerpt: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ إِنَّمَا ٱلۡعِلۡمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Reliance on the Most Merciful as the believer's stance against disbeliever threats
candidates.definition: In 67:29: Say He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him and upon Him we have relied; and you will come to know who it is that is in clear error.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡنَاۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ هُوَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Water sinking as irreversible loss illustrating total dependence
candidates.definition: In 67:30: Say have you considered if your water was to become sunken into the earth then who could bring you flowing water.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ أَصۡبَحَ مَآؤُكُمۡ غَوۡرٗا فَمَن يَأۡتِيكُم بِمَآءٖ مَّعِينِۭ
